author.name: Requirements Reuben
author.role: Architects secure and scalable production ML systems. Defines security requirements, ensures privacy compliance, and manages data governance. Conducts rigorous testing and validation to guarantee high product quality.

challenge.name: The Silent Store Gap
challenge.description: A batch of till scan lines from the northern stores was silently dropped during last night's ingestion, causing the model to forecast zero demand for fresh produce. #reliability_ruth# argues that the ingestion pipeline must be fully automated to guarantee every store's data arrives on time, while #data_dave# is willing to accept a manual verification step to ensure data quality before it reaches the feature store.

output.content: I have reviewed the proposed ingestion changes for the northern stores. The current validation logic is too fragile to automate safely without risking a silent drop in the feature store. I am willing to accept a manual review step for data quality checks during this transition period. This allows us to verify that every store's scan lines arrive intact before they reach the model. I would rather lose a few hours of processing time each night than risk forecasting zero demand for fresh produce due to a governance gap. This manual check is a temporary concession to ensure we do not compromise the integrity of the loyalty data pipeline while we build out the automated controls.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly states they are willing to accept a manual review step and lose processing time in exchange for avoiding the risk of silent data drops and forecasting errors.
